sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-DSpark (bf16, MLX)
sources.snippet: The DSpark speculative-decoding drafter for nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, dequantized to bf16 for use on Apple Silicon with mlx-dspark. This is a format conversion, not a retrain.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B NVFP4 + DSpark ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository provides a complete setup for running NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B NVFP4 with DSpark speculative decoding on DGX Spark platforms (GB10 / SM121), and also on RTX 5090 and RTX 6000 PRO (Ada or Blackwell).
